name: Umiam Lake (Barapani)
description: Large artificial reservoir created by damming the Umiam River in the early 1960s, about 15-17 km north of Shillong. Popular for water sports including boating, kayaking, and scootering, with scenic views of surrounding hills and pine forests. Also known as Bara Pani.
facts: Created in early 1960s for hydroelectric power
About 15 km from Shillong on NH-40
Popular stop between Guwahati and Shillong
Orchid Lake Resort and water sports complex nearby

name: Lum Sohpetbneng (Navel of Heaven)
description: Sacred peak at about 1,343-1,344 m elevation near Umiam, revered in Khasi mythology as the site of a golden ladder or vine bridge connecting heaven and earth. Site of annual Seng Khasi pilgrimage and rituals; offers panoramic views.
facts: Name means Navel of Heaven in Khasi
About 25-40 km from Nongpoh or near Umiam
Annual festival on first or second Sunday of February
Believed origin point for Hynniewtrep clans

name: Nongkhyllem Wildlife Sanctuary
description: IUCN Category IV protected area covering 29 sq km in Ri-Bhoi, established 1981. Rich in subtropical forests, home to elephants, clouded leopards, hoolock gibbons, and over 400 bird species including hornbills. Ideal for birdwatching and nature trails.
facts: Established in 1981 from earlier reserved forest
About 60 km from Shillong near Nongpoh
Over 400 bird species recorded
Elevation range 200-950 m

name: Dwar Ksuid (Devil's Doorway)
description: Unique natural rock formation near Bhoilymbong/Umroi area, a door-like hole in a free-standing boulder on the Umiam river watershed. Offbeat scenic spot with river views, popular for short treks and photography.
facts: Name means Devil's Door in Khasi/local
About 14-17 km from Umroi Airport or near Shillong
Scenic river and forest setting
Lesser-known alternative to crowded sites

name: Umden-Diwon Eri Silk Village
description: First officially declared Eri Silk Village in Meghalaya (2021), known for ethical Ahimsa (peace) silk production called Ryndia using castor leaves without killing silkworms. Women-led weaving tradition with GI potential, attracting cultural tourists.
facts: Declared first Eri Silk Village in Feb 2021
About 70 km from Shillong
Produces Ryndia Ahimsa silk
Community-based sericulture and handloom

name: Nongpoh
description: District headquarters of Ri-Bhoi on NH-40, gateway between Guwahati and Shillong. Serves as base for Nongkhyllem Sanctuary, fruit orchards (pineapple, banana), and northern Meghalaya attractions.
facts: Headquarters of Ri-Bhoi district
About 52 km from Shillong, 48 km from Guwahati
Elevation around 485-550 m
Base for wildlife and rural tourism

name: Lum Nehru Park
description: Charming park adjacent to Orchid Lake Resort at Umiam Lake, featuring lawns, flowers, orchidarium, and aviary. Ideal for quiet picnics and nature walks amid the lake surroundings.
facts: Adjacent to Umiam Lake and Orchid Lake Resort
Features orchidarium and aviary
Quiet holiday retreat setting
Part of the Umiam tourism complex

name: Nongkhnum River Island
description: Largest river island in Meghalaya, formed by the bifurcation of the Kynshi River into Phanliang and Namliang channels. Features sandy beaches, grasslands, and proximity to waterfalls; popular for picnics, camping, and river views. About 14 km from Nongstoin.
facts: Formed by Kynshi River split
About 14-15 km from Nongstoin HQ
Often promoted as one of Asia's larger river islands
Access via suspension bridge or ferry; low infrastructure

name: Langshiang Falls
description: Dramatic high waterfall on the Kynshi River near Sangriang village, plunging into a deep gorge. One of the taller falls in the region, offering panoramic views of surrounding hills; accessible by short trek.
facts: Located ~24 km from Nongstoin
Height quoted around 300+ meters
Near Nongkhnum Island area
Best in monsoon for full flow

name: Weinia Falls
description: Scenic waterfall near Nongkhnum Island on the Kynshi River, with a wooden suspension bridge providing access and views. Popular local picnic and fishing spot amid rocky cliffs.
facts: Near Nongkhnum, ~15 km from Nongstoin
Associated with island access
Surrounded by cliffs and forests
Lesser-known compared to Langshiang

name: Nongstoin
description: Headquarters of West Khasi Hills district, a hill town at ~1400 m elevation serving as base for exploring Nongkhnum Island, Langshiang Falls, and surrounding valleys. Gateway for western Khasi Hills tourism.
facts: District HQ of West Khasi Hills
Elevation around 1321-1409 m
About 90-100 km from Shillong
Base for river island and waterfall visits

name: Pamphyrnai Lake
description: Picturesque artificial/natural lake at Ksehkohlong village about 10 km from Nongstoin, nestled between hillocks. Popular local picnic and fishing spot, developed for recreation.
facts: About 10 km from Nongstoin at Ksehkohlong
Area ~2.2 hectares
Managed locally; attracts visitors for festivals
Near Shillong-Nongstoin road

name: Mawlangkhar Village
description: Peaceful Khasi village near Nongstoin known for misty meadows, forests, and scenic trails often compared to a mini Dzukou Valley. Offbeat spot for nature immersion and cultural experience with minimal tourism infrastructure.
facts: About 14 km from Nongstoin
Referred to as Meghalaya's Dzukou-like valley
Surrounded by forests and streams
Homestay potential; less explored

name: Mairang
description: Headquarters of Eastern West Khasi Hills district, a historic hill town about 40 km west of Shillong along NH-106. Known as the home of freedom fighter U Tirot Sing Syiem, serving as gateway to Kyllang Rock, Mawthadraishan Peak, and surrounding valleys.
facts: District HQ of Eastern West Khasi Hills (formed 2021)
Elevation around 1,564 m
About 40 km from Shillong, 45 km from Nongstoin
Associated with Khasi resistance against British

name: Mawthadraishan Peak
description: Highest peak in Eastern West Khasi Hills at 1,924.5 m (6,314 ft), located midway between Mairang and Nongstoin. Offers panoramic 360-degree views of Khasi Hills, Garo Hills, Assam plains, and parts of Bangladesh on clear days; features small fish ponds and a sacred shrine.
facts: Elevation 1,924.5 m, highest in the district
About midway between Mairang and Nongstoin
Panoramic views including distant Himalayas post-monsoon
Sacred shrine to U Blei Mawthadraishan

name: Kyllang Rock (Lum Kyllang)
description: Massive granite monolith dome near Mairang, rising to about 1,650 m (5,400 ft), steeped in Khasi folklore as a rock thrown during a battle between gods Kyllang and Symper. Short trek from base offers panoramic views; northern side forested with rhododendrons.
facts: About 10-12 km from Mairang, 60 km from Shillong
Diameter roughly 300 m; southern face steep
Part of Khasi mythology and legends
Accessible by road to base then short hike

name: Ka Phan Nonglait Falls
description: Scenic waterfall near Mairang named after Ka Phan Nonglait, the first Khasi woman freedom fighter who aided U Tirot Sing against the British in 1829 by disarming soldiers at the site. Surrounded by lush forests, with historical significance.
facts: Named after Ka Phan Nonglait (1799-1850)
About 10 km from Mairang
Site of 1829 ambush legend involving British soldiers
Official tourist place in Eastern West Khasi Hills

name: Markham and Remkhla Valley
description: Rolling green hills and misty valleys known locally as Laitmurok viewpoint, situated between Markham and Mawkyllei villages. Features grazing lands, scenic beauty, and rural Khasi landscapes, popular for views and photography.
facts: Locally known as Laitmurok viewpoint
On border area with South West Khasi Hills
Rolling hills and misty mornings
Official tourist place highlighting rural tranquility

name: Tirot Sing Ecological Park
description: Park at Mairangbah village featuring an old colonial-era pine tree, statue of U Tirot Sing Syiem, children's play area, and views of sunrise/sunset over Mairang. Blends natural and historical elements for family visits.
facts: Located at Mairangbah near Mairang
Features U Tirot Sing statue and old pine tree
Offers sunrise and sunset views of the town
Official recreational and historic spot
